# Conformance matrix

<!-- ste: descriptive | generated by zig build spec-matrix from docs/spec/requirements.zon and docs/spec/requirement_tests.zon -->

This page maps each normative sentence of MCP specification revision 2026-07-28 to the tests of the SDK. A normative sentence has an RFC 2119 keyword in uppercase. The sentences come from the specification pages at commit `046fa30efd374370afb87ef830bd788eac5f217e` of https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol, vendored in `test/fixtures/mcp_spec_2026_07_28`. The quoted text is licensed by the MCP project under the license in that directory.

Tests are Zig tests of this repository and scenarios of the conformance suite `@modelcontextprotocol/conformance@0.2.0-alpha.11`. The CI job `conformance` runs the scenarios.

## Status values

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| tested | One or more tests check the requirement. |
| n/a | The requirement does not apply to the SDK. The reason tells why. |
| app | The application that uses the SDK is responsible. The reason tells what the SDK gives. |
| gap | No test checks the requirement yet. The reason tells what is missing. |

## Summary

The specification has 733 normative sentences. 393 are MUST or MUST NOT requirements. Of these, 285 are tested, 28 do not apply, 80 are for the application and 0 are gaps.

The column Covered gives the part of the requirements that has a test, an n/a reason or an app reason.

## Requirements

### basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery

Specification page: <https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery>

| Id | Keyword | Party | Requirement | Status | Tests or reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#001-3cb045](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-location) | MUST | server | MCP servers MUST implement the OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC9728) specification to indicate the locations of authorization servers. | tested | [http_auth_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_auth_test.zig): resource server: metadata, challenges and the principal<br>[resource_server.zig](../../src/mcp/auth/resource_server.zig): challenges and decisions (The HTTP server serves the RFC 9728 document from ResourceServer.metadataJson.) |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#002-fdbecb](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-location) | MUST | server | The Protected Resource Metadata document returned by the MCP server MUST include the `authorization_servers` field containing at least one authorization server. | tested | [resource_server.zig](../../src/mcp/auth/resource_server.zig): challenges and decisions (The document lists the configured authorization servers. The SDK does not reject an empty list.) |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#003-bec089](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-location) | MUST | client | Clients MUST maintain separate registration state (client credentials, tokens) per authorization server and MUST NOT assume that credentials valid for one authorization server will be accepted by another. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client uses the pre-registered credentials of each issuer and fails for an unknown issuer<br>[authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client registers again and keeps no credentials of the old authorization server after a change<br>[oauth_client.zig](../../src/mcp/auth/oauth_client.zig): pre-registered credentials are keyed by issuer<br>`conformance:client/auth/authorization-server-migration` (Registration.pre_registered takes one entry for each issuer. A change of issuer clears the registration and the tokens of the old authorization server.) |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#004-e296db](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements) | MUST | server | MCP servers MUST implement one of the following discovery mechanisms to provide authorization server location information to MCP clients: WWW-Authenticate Header: Include the resource metadata URL in the `WWW-Authenticate` HTTP header under `resource_metadata` when returning `401 Unauthorized` responses, as described in RFC9728 Section 5.1. | tested | [http_auth_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_auth_test.zig): resource server: metadata, challenges and the principal<br>[resource_server.zig](../../src/mcp/auth/resource_server.zig): challenges and decisions |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#005-07b364](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements) | MUST | server | MCP servers MUST implement one of the following discovery mechanisms to provide authorization server location information to MCP clients: Well-Known URI: Serve metadata at a well-known URI as specified in RFC9728. | tested | [http_auth_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_auth_test.zig): resource server: metadata, challenges and the principal (The server serves the document at the path-inserted well-known URI.) |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#006-7b3f9c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements) | MUST | client | MCP clients MUST support both discovery mechanisms and use the resource metadata URL from the parsed `WWW-Authenticate` headers when present; otherwise, they MUST fall back to constructing and requesting the well-known URIs in the order listed above. | tested | `conformance:client/auth/metadata-default`<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var1`<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var2`<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var3`<br>[authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client without a challenge URL falls back to well-known resource and server metadata in order |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#007-306b0f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements) | MUST | client | MCP clients MUST be able to parse `WWW-Authenticate` headers and respond appropriately to `HTTP 401 Unauthorized` responses from the MCP server. | tested | [common.zig](../../src/mcp/auth/common.zig): challenge parsing<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-default`<br>`conformance:client/auth/scope-from-www-authenticate` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#008-7a2391](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | To handle different issuer URL formats and ensure interoperability with both OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata and OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 specifications, MCP clients MUST attempt multiple well-known endpoints when discovering authorization server metadata. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client tries the three well-known locations in order for an issuer with a path<br>[authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client without a challenge URL falls back to well-known resource and server metadata in order<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var1`<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var3` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#009-0199fa](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | For issuer URLs with path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com/tenant1`), clients MUST try endpoints in the following priority order: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata with path insertion: `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/tenant1` | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client tries the three well-known locations in order for an issuer with a path<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var2` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#010-2f643d](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | For issuer URLs with path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com/tenant1`), clients MUST try endpoints in the following priority order: OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 with path insertion: `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration/tenant1` | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client tries the three well-known locations in order for an issuer with a path<br>[authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client uses openid configuration with path insertion for an issuer with a path |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#011-139a23](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | For issuer URLs with path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com/tenant1`), clients MUST try endpoints in the following priority order: OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 path appending: `https://auth.example.com/tenant1/.well-known/openid-configuration` | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client tries the three well-known locations in order for an issuer with a path<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var3` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#012-45aa38](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | For issuer URLs without path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com`), clients MUST try: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata: `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client without a challenge URL falls back to well-known resource and server metadata in order<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-default` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#013-ce9c0e](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | For issuer URLs without path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com`), clients MUST try: OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0: `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration` | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client without a challenge URL falls back to well-known resource and server metadata in order<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-var1` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#014-25f4f1](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | client | After retrieving a metadata document, MCP clients MUST validate it as required by RFC8414 Section 3.3 or OpenID Connect Discovery Section 4.3: the `issuer` value in the document MUST be identical to the issuer identifier used to construct the well-known URL. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client rejects authorization server metadata whose issuer differs from the queried issuer<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-issuer-mismatch` |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#015-87796f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST NOT | client | If they differ, the client MUST NOT use the metadata. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client rejects authorization server metadata whose issuer differs from the queried issuer<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-issuer-mismatch` (No endpoint of the rejected document is used.) |
| [basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#016-519ccd](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#authorization-server-metadata-discovery) | MUST | both | For example, a document fetched from `https://attacker.example/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` that contains `"issuer": "https://honest.example"` MUST be rejected. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client rejects authorization server metadata whose issuer differs from the queried issuer<br>`conformance:client/auth/metadata-issuer-mismatch` |

| [basic/authorization/security-considerations#035-655246](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/security-considerations#access-token-privilege-restriction) | MUST | client | MCP clients MUST implement and use the `resource` parameter as defined in RFC 8707 - Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0 to explicitly specify the target resource for which the token is being requested. | tested | [authorization_discovery_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/authorization_discovery_test.zig): client sends the resource parameter and an S256 PKCE challenge in authorization and token requests<br>`conformance:client/auth/token-endpoint-auth-basic`<br>`conformance:client/auth/token-endpoint-auth-post`<br>`conformance:client/auth/token-endpoint-auth-none` (The harness checks resource-parameter-valid-uri and resource-parameter-consistency.) |

| [basic#058-24204d](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#_meta) | MUST | server | If processing a request requires a capability the client did not include in `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities`, the server MUST return a `MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError` (`-32021`) whose `data.requiredCapabilities` lists the missing capabilities. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): tools list and call<br>[base_protocol_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/base_protocol_test.zig): the server takes capabilities from each request and not from the connection<br>`conformance:server/server-stateless` |

| [basic#067-30920b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | SHOULD | client | Clients that support rendering icons SHOULD also support: `image/webp` - WebP images (modern, efficient format) | app | The host renders icons. | [basic#069-b1629f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Ensure that the icon URI is either a HTTPS or `data:` URI. | app | The host checks the icon URI scheme before a fetch. | [basic#070-8d84c6](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | client | Clients MUST reject icon URIs that use unsafe schemes and redirects, such as `javascript:`, `file:`, `ftp:`, `ws:`, or local app URI schemes. | app | The host rejects unsafe icon schemes and redirects. The SDK client passes icon metadata through unchanged. |
| [basic#071-893be4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Disallow scheme changes and redirects to hosts on different origins. | app | The host controls icon fetches and redirects. The SDK never fetches icon URIs. |
| [basic#072-c4f8d3](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Be resilient against resource exhaustion attacks stemming from oversized images, large dimensions, or excessive frames (e.g., in GIFs). | app | The host decodes icon images. The SDK never decodes icon bytes. |
| [basic#073-ce40c1](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MAY | both | Consumers MAY set limits for image and content size. | app | The host sets image size limits. The SDK never fetches icons. |
| [basic#074-5ecfe2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Fetch icons without credentials. | app | The host fetches icons without credentials. The SDK never fetches icon URIs. |
| [basic#075-5698de](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Verify that icon URIs are from the same origin as the server. | app | The host compares the icon origin with the server origin. The SDK never fetches icon URIs. |
| [basic#076-2e0da4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MAY | both | Exercise caution when fetching and rendering icons as the payload MAY contain executable content (e.g., SVG with embedded JavaScript or extended capabilities). | app | The host renders icons and handles executable content. The SDK renders nothing. |
| [basic#077-8b74f1](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MAY | both | Consumers MAY choose to disallow specific file types or otherwise sanitize icon files before rendering. | app | The host filters or sanitizes icon files. The SDK never handles icon bytes. |
| [basic#078-8e73cf](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Validate MIME types and file contents before rendering. | app | The host checks MIME types and magic bytes before it renders. The SDK never handles icon bytes. |
| [basic#079-0fb934](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic#icons) | MUST | both | Consumers of icon metadata MUST take appropriate security precautions when handling icons to prevent compromise: Maintain a strict allowlist of image types. | app | The host keeps the allowlist of image types. The SDK never handles icon bytes. |
### basic/patterns/cancellation

Specification page: <https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation>

| Id | Keyword | Party | Requirement | Status | Tests or reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#001-981e1d](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation) | SHOULD | client | A client SHOULD send a cancellation notification to indicate that a request it previously issued should be terminated. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (On stdio a fired cancel token makes the client send notifications/cancelled. On HTTP the client closes the stream.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#002-e315cd](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation) | MUST | server | A server MUST send `notifications/cancelled` referencing a `subscriptions/listen` request ID when it tears down that subscription stream (see [Subscriptions][subscriptions]). | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (Only the stdio server sends it. The HTTP server ends the stream after the listen result.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#003-68c7d9](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation) | MUST NOT | server | Servers MUST NOT send `notifications/cancelled` for any other purpose. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server takes a client cancellation with the reason server shutdown as a client cancellation<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled<br>[Transport.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/Transport.zig): only the first cancellation counts, and only shutdown marks the server as the origin (The stdio server sends notifications/cancelled only after the result of a listen stream that it ends at shutdown. A flag of the cancel token tells a shutdown, not the reason text.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#004-0ab0e3](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#transport-specific-cancellation) | MUST | server | The server MUST treat a client disconnect as cancellation of that request. | tested | [transports_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/transports_test.zig): streamable http server cancels a handler that only polls when the client disconnects<br>[transports_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/transports_test.zig): streamable http server ends an idle listen stream when the client disconnects<br>[transports_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/transports_test.zig): streamable http server treats a closed SSE stream as the cancellation of the request<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): http server stops a handler that writes after the client disconnects (A task reads the socket while the handler runs. The end of the connection fires the cancel token, also for a handler that does not write.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#005-e1786e](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#transport-specific-cancellation) | MUST | client | The client MUST send a `notifications/cancelled` notification referencing the request ID. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (At shutdown the server process names only the stream that the client did not cancel.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#006-ed6274](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#timeouts) | SHOULD | both | Implementations SHOULD establish timeouts for all sent requests, to prevent hung connections and resource exhaustion. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): client gives every request a default timeout and a maximum timeout, but not a listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): client cancels a request at the default timeout although progress keeps arriving (A request without RequestOptions.timeout gets limits.request_timeout (60 s). A listen stream is long-lived and gets no default timeout.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#007-6ae573](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#timeouts) | SHOULD | both | When the request has not received a success or error response within the timeout period, the sender SHOULD cancel the request and stop waiting for a response. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart<br>[http_client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_client_test.zig): http client: json, sse, header mirroring and mrtr (A timeout returns error.Timeout. On stdio it also sends notifications/cancelled.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#008-6a2cad](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#timeouts) | SHOULD | both | SDKs and other middleware SHOULD allow these timeouts to be configured on a per-request basis. | tested | [http_client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_client_test.zig): http client: json, sse, header mirroring and mrtr<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (RequestOptions.timeout is set for each request.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#009-d579ef](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#timeouts) | MAY | both | Implementations MAY choose to reset the timeout clock when receiving a progress notification corresponding to the request, as this implies that work is actually happening. | n/a | Optional behaviour that the SDK does not implement. Progress does not reset the timeout. |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#010-6c2d1f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#timeouts) | SHOULD | both | However, implementations SHOULD always enforce a maximum timeout, regardless of progress notifications, to limit the impact of a misbehaving client or server. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): client gives every request a default timeout and a maximum timeout, but not a listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): client cancels a request at the default timeout although progress keeps arriving (RequestOptions.max_total_timeout, or else limits.max_total_timeout (600 s), limits every timeout. | [basic/patterns/cancellation#011-182b4a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | MUST | both | Cancellation notifications MUST only reference requests that: Were previously issued by the client | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (The client cancels only the id of its own exchange.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#012-3d7581](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | MUST | both | Cancellation notifications MUST only reference requests that: Are believed to still be in-progress | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (The client sends the notification only while the exchange waits for the response.) |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#013-175e99](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | MUST | server | Server-sent cancellation notifications MUST reference a `subscriptions/listen` request, to terminate that subscription stream | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server takes a client cancellation with the reason server shutdown as a client cancellation<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (The stdio server sends notifications/cancelled only for a listen request that it ends at shutdown. | [basic/patterns/cancellation#015-23e438](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | SHOULD | server | Servers receiving cancellation notifications SHOULD: Free associated resources | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): a client-cancelled listen stream frees its subscription and gets no response<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server stops a cancelled request and ignores invalid cancellations (The subscription and the request slot are freed. | [basic/patterns/cancellation#016-291f6c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | SHOULD | server | Servers receiving cancellation notifications SHOULD: Not send a response for the cancelled request | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server stops a cancelled request and ignores invalid cancellations<br>[server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): client-cancelled listen stream gets no response |
| [basic/patterns/cancellation#017-ad3fdd](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | MAY | server | Servers MAY ignore cancellation notifications if: The referenced request is unknown | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server stops a cancelled request and ignores invalid cancellations |

| [basic/patterns/cancellation#019-4ca65a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/cancellation#behavior-requirements) | MAY | server | Servers MAY ignore cancellation notifications if: The request cannot be cancelled | app | The handler decides. | [basic/patterns#002-78811a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns#request-and-response) | MAY | server | While the request is in flight, the server MAY send notifications scoped to it, such as `notifications/progress` and `notifications/message`. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): tools list and call<br>[http_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_test.zig): http sse response with progress notifications<br>`conformance:server/tools-call-with-progress` |

| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#001-31f5dc](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#opening-a-stream) | MUST NOT | server | The server MUST NOT send notification types the client has not explicitly requested. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): subscriptions listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): a client-cancelled listen stream frees its subscription and gets no response (A prompts change does not reach a tools-only subscription.) |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#002-ba33b0](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#acknowledgment) | MUST | server | The server MUST send `notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged` as the first message carrying the subscription's ID in `_meta` under `io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId`, and MUST NOT send any notification on the subscription before it. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): subscriptions listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#003-f96346](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#acknowledgment) | MAY | both | On stdio, where every subscription shares one channel, this ordering is defined per subscription ID and not per channel: messages belonging to other subscriptions MAY be interleaved before it. | n/a | A permission that relaxes the ordering of basic/patterns/subscriptions#002 on stdio. It puts no duty on the SDK. |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#004-1a6d46](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#acknowledgment) | SHOULD | client | The client SHOULD check the acknowledged filter against what it requested and handle any unsupported types gracefully. | app | The application compares the filters. It gets the acknowledgement through RequestOptions.on_notification. |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#005-5d0dfb](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#receiving-notifications) | MUST | client | On stdio, where all messages share a single channel, clients MUST use this field to correlate notifications with their originating subscription. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart (Each concurrent listen stream gets only the acknowledgement with its own subscription id.) |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#006-32c573](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#multiple-concurrent-subscriptions) | MAY | client | A client MAY have multiple active subscriptions concurrently — for example, one listening for tools-list changes and another for resource updates. | tested | [patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio client cancels requests with notifications/cancelled and keeps listen streams apart |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#007-0c5b5f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#cancellation) | SHOULD | server | The server tears it down (e.g., during shutdown) — it SHOULD send a successful `subscriptions/listen` response to signal a graceful end (see Graceful Closure), then close the stream. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): subscriptions listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#008-fd9c08](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#graceful-closure) | SHOULD | server | When the server ends a subscription on its own initiative (for example, during shutdown), it SHOULD respond to the original `subscriptions/listen` request with a completion result before closing the stream. | tested | [server_test.zig](../../src/mcp/server/server_test.zig): subscriptions listen stream<br>[patterns_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/patterns_test.zig): stdio server ends a listen stream with a result and then notifications/cancelled |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#009-0d786c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#graceful-closure) | MAY | client | A client that receives this response knows the subscription closed cleanly; a transport that closes without it indicates an unexpected disconnect, which the client MAY treat as a trigger to reconnect. | app | The application decides to reconnect. Client.listen returns the result on a graceful end and an error on a drop. |
| [basic/patterns/subscriptions#010-5451d2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions#graceful-closure) | MUST | client | On stdio, if the connection is terminated and then re-established, the client MUST re-send `subscriptions/listen` to re-establish its subscriptions — the server holds no subscription state across reconnections. | app | The application calls Client.listen again after a reconnect. RequestOptions.retry set to force re-issues it. |

| [basic/transports#002-3b4ee2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#messages) | MUST | both | A binding MUST deliver client-sent requests and notifications to the server, and server-sent responses and notifications to the client. | tested | [client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/client/client_test.zig): stdio client drives the example server process<br>[http_client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_client_test.zig): http client: json, sse, header mirroring and mrtr<br>[grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: discover, tools, progress, header mirroring, mrtr and errors (Requests reach the server and responses and progress notifications reach the client on stdio, HTTP and gRPC.) |
| [basic/transports#003-02b9f4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#request-metadata) | MAY | both | A binding MAY additionally mirror selected body fields into envelope metadata. | tested | [http_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_test.zig): http ladder and json responses<br>[http_client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_client_test.zig): http client: json, sse, header mirroring and mrtr<br>[grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: discover, tools, progress, header mirroring, mrtr and errors (HTTP headers and gRPC metadata mirror body fields.) |
| [basic/transports#004-8207a0](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#custom-transports) | MAY | both | Clients and servers MAY implement additional custom transport mechanisms to suit their specific needs. | tested | [grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: discover, tools, progress, header mirroring, mrtr and errors<br>[grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: a listen stream delivers events until the client cancels (The gRPC transport is the custom transport of the SDK.) |
| [basic/transports#005-ca7691](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#custom-transports) | MUST | both | Implementers who choose to support custom transports MUST preserve the JSON-RPC message format, the message patterns, and the per-request metadata model. | tested | [grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: discover, tools, progress, header mirroring, mrtr and errors<br>[grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: a listen stream delivers events until the client cancels<br>[grpc_test.zig](../../src/grpc/grpc_test.zig): grpc: unknown path, wrong content type and missing metadata (JSON-RPC messages with _meta, progress, MRTR, listen streams and errors travel unchanged over gRPC.) |
| [basic/transports#006-8728f0](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#custom-transports) | SHOULD | both | Custom transports SHOULD document their connection establishment, message framing, and cancellation patterns to aid interoperability. | n/a | A documentation duty that no test can check. The files proto/README.md and proto/mcp_zig_transport_v1.proto describe the gRPC binding. |
| [basic/transports#007-c2495c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports#custom-transports) | SHOULD | both | Custom transports that run over a reliable bidirectional byte stream (e.g., Unix domain sockets or TCP) SHOULD reuse the stdio framing rather than defining a new one: the stdio binding is just newline-delimited JSON-RPC over a byte stream, and only its process-lifecycle rules are specific to standard streams. | app | The SDK has no custom transport over a raw byte stream. An application that builds one can use mcp.util.line_framer, the stdio framing. |

| [basic/versioning#007-6202a2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/versioning#extension-negotiation) | SHOULD | both | Extensions SHOULD document their expected fallback behavior. | n/a | Duty of extension authors. | [client/elicitation#015-8bf2e6](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#requested-schema) | SHOULD | client | Clients that support defaults SHOULD pre-populate form fields with these values. | app | The host UI fills the form fields. The SDK parses the default value of each primitive schema. |
| [client/elicitation#016-fab8c9](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#url-mode-elicitation-requests) | MUST | client | URL mode elicitation requests MUST specify `mode: "url"`, a `message`, and include these additional parameters: | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): elicitation requests without the required parameters do not parse (A URL request without url or message does not parse.) |
| [client/elicitation#017-ff2b57](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#url-mode-elicitation-requests) | MUST | client | The `url` parameter MUST contain a valid URL. | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): URL elicitation needs a valid absolute URL on the server and on the client<br>[types.zig](../../src/mcp/protocol/types.zig): valid URLs for URL elicitation<br>[mrtr.zig](../../src/mcp/server/mrtr.zig): input required builder |
| [client/elicitation#018-70482f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#example-request-sensitive-data) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD provide manual controls that let the user retry or cancel the original request (or otherwise resume interacting with the client). | app | The host UI gives the retry and cancel controls. The SDK gives RequestOptions.cancel and allow_input_required. |
| [client/elicitation#019-12f395](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#statefulness) | MUST | server | However, if state is stored, servers implementing elicitation MUST securely associate this state with individual users following the guidelines in the security best practices document. | app | The server author stores and binds state to users. The SDK seals requestState, but see elicitation#028. |
| [client/elicitation#020-a4073e](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#statefulness) | MUST | client | State storage MUST be protected against unauthorized access | app | The server author protects its state storage. The SDK seals requestState with a server key. |
| [client/elicitation#021-8cb322](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#statefulness) | MUST | server | For remote MCP servers, user identification MUST be derived from credentials acquired via MCP authorization when possible (e.g. `sub` claim) | app | The handler identifies the user. The SDK gives RequestContext.principal with the verified token claims. |
| [client/elicitation#022-db9b69](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#url-mode-elicitation-for-oauth-flows) | MUST NOT | server | MCP servers MUST NOT rely on URL mode elicitation to authorize users for themselves. | app | The server author uses MCP authorization for its own users. The SDK gives the resource server in auth/resource_server.zig. |
| [client/elicitation#023-38668d](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#understanding-the-distinction) | MUST NOT | client | The third-party credentials MUST NOT transit through the MCP client: The client must never see third-party credentials to protect the security boundary | app | The server design keeps third-party credentials out of band. The client refuses URL mode answers that carry content. |
| [client/elicitation#024-6d7d4a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#understanding-the-distinction) | MUST NOT | server | The MCP server MUST NOT use the client's credentials for the third-party service: That would be token passthrough, which is forbidden | app | The server author must not pass the client token to a third party. The handler code makes all third-party calls. |
| [client/elicitation#025-59c9a4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#understanding-the-distinction) | MUST | client | The user MUST authorize the MCP server directly: The interaction happens outside the MCP protocol, without involving the MCP client | app | The user authorizes the server in the browser, outside the protocol. The SDK has no part in this flow. |
| [client/elicitation#026-da3b32](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#understanding-the-distinction) | MUST NOT | server | The MCP server MUST NOT transmit credentials obtained through URL mode elicitation to the MCP client. | app | The server author keeps the third-party credentials. The SDK sends only what the handler returns. |
| [client/elicitation#027-43d41c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#error-handling) | MUST | server | Servers SHOULD NOT assume that elicitation requests will always succeed, and MUST handle cases where the user declines or cancels the elicitation, or where the client fails to process the request. | app | The handler handles decline, cancel and missing answers. RequestContext.elicitResponse gives the action, or null when no answer came. |
| [client/elicitation#028-302fe6](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#security-considerations) | MUST | server | Servers MUST bind elicitation requests to the client and user identity | tested | [http_auth_test.zig](../../src/mcp/transport/http_auth_test.zig): resource server: sealed request state opens only for the principal that it was sealed for<br>[request_state.zig](../../src/mcp/server/request_state.zig): sealed state is bound to the principal (The sealed requestState of an input round opens only for the same user (issuer and subject) and the same client (client_id). Handlers read the principal with RequestContext.principal.) |
| [client/elicitation#029-2d0c6c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#security-considerations) | MUST | client | Clients MUST provide clear indication of which server is requesting information | app | The host UI shows which server asks. Each Client serves one server, and Hooks.userdata lets the host identify it. |
| [client/elicitation#030-ec4f08](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#security-considerations) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD implement user approval controls | app | The host adds approval controls in the elicitation hooks. |
| [client/elicitation#031-a08004](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#security-considerations) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD allow users to decline elicitation requests at any time | app | The host lets the user decline. The hooks return the decline action. |
| [client/elicitation#032-4cd204](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#security-considerations) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD present elicitation requests in a way that makes it clear what information is being requested and why | app | The host UI shows the message and the requested schema that the hooks receive. |
| [client/elicitation#033-4fed5b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST NOT | server | MCP servers requesting elicitation: MUST NOT include sensitive information about the end-user, including credentials, personally identifiable information, etc., in the URL sent to the client in a URL elicitation request. | app | The server author builds the URL. The SDK sends the URL that the handler gives. |
| [client/elicitation#034-2cf25e](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST NOT | server | MCP servers requesting elicitation: MUST NOT provide a URL which is pre-authenticated to access a protected resource, as the URL could be used to impersonate the user by a malicious client. | app | The server author builds the URL. The SDK sends the URL that the handler gives. |
| [client/elicitation#035-7d04ab](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | SHOULD NOT | server | MCP servers requesting elicitation: SHOULD NOT include URLs intended to be clickable in any field of a form mode elicitation request. | app | The server author writes the form text. The SDK does not examine it. |
| [client/elicitation#036-927b91](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | SHOULD | server | MCP servers requesting elicitation: SHOULD use HTTPS URLs for non-development environments. | app | The server author selects the URL scheme. The SDK does not check it. |
| [client/elicitation#037-f7ff6b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST | client | Clients implementing URL mode elicitation MUST handle URLs carefully to prevent users from unknowingly clicking malicious links. | app | The host handles the URL in the elicit_url hook. The SDK does not open or fetch the URL. |
| [client/elicitation#038-671fc5](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST NOT | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: MUST NOT automatically pre-fetch the URL or any of its metadata. | app | The SDK never fetches the URL. The host must not fetch it in the elicit_url hook. |
| [client/elicitation#039-898f14](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST NOT | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: MUST NOT open the URL without explicit consent from the user. | app | The host asks for consent in the elicit_url hook. The SDK never opens the URL. |
| [client/elicitation#040-1b6c2f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: MUST show the full URL to the user for examination before consent. | app | The host UI shows the full URL that the elicit_url hook receives. |
| [client/elicitation#041-6ac848](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | MUST | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: MUST open the URL provided by the server in a secure manner that does not enable the client or LLM to inspect the content or user inputs. | app | The host selects a secure browser view. The SDK does not open URLs. |
| [client/elicitation#042-5934f2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | SHOULD | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: SHOULD highlight the domain of the URL to mitigate subdomain spoofing. | app | The host UI highlights the domain. |
| [client/elicitation#043-654dee](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | SHOULD | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: SHOULD have warnings for ambiguous/suspicious URIs (i.e., containing Punycode). | app | The host UI shows the warnings for suspicious URLs. |
| [client/elicitation#044-82c380](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#safe-url-handling) | SHOULD NOT | client | When handling URL mode elicitation requests, MCP clients: SHOULD NOT render URLs as clickable in any field of an elicitation request, except for the `url` field in a URL elicitation request (with the restrictions detailed above). | app | The host UI decides how to render the text of the request. |
| [client/elicitation#045-9c7f68](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#identifying-the-user) | MUST NOT | server | Servers MUST NOT rely on client-provided user identification without server verification, as this can be forged. | app | The handler uses RequestContext.principal from the verified token, not an identity that the client supplies. |
| [client/elicitation#046-a68e26](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#identifying-the-user) | SHOULD | server | Instead, servers SHOULD follow security best practices. | app | The server author follows the security best practices. The SDK gives the resource server and RequestContext.principal. |
| [client/elicitation#047-6cd76a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#form-mode-security) | MUST NOT | server | Servers MUST NOT request sensitive information (passwords, API keys, etc.) via form mode | app | The server author decides what a form asks for. The SDK cannot detect sensitive fields in a schema. |
| [client/elicitation#048-a08fcb](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#form-mode-security) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD validate all responses against the provided schema | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): client validates the form answer against the requested schema |
| [client/elicitation#049-557a99](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#form-mode-security) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD validate received data matches the requested schema | app | The handler validates the answer. The server keeps no schema between rounds, and the SDK gives mcp.schema.validator. |
| [client/elicitation#050-a75c09](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#phishing) | MUST | server | The MCP Server MUST verify the identity of the user who opens the URL before accepting information. | app | The server author checks the user at the URL page. The SDK does not serve that page. |
| [client/elicitation#051-51ff15](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#phishing) | MUST | server | To prevent this attack, the server MUST ensure that the user who started the elicitation request (the end-user who is accessing the server via the MCP client) is the same user who completes the authorization flow. | app | The server author checks that the same user completes the flow. The SDK does not serve that page. |
| [client/elicitation#052-6183b2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/elicitation#phishing) | MUST | server | In all implementations, the server MUST ensure that the mechanism to determine the user's identity is resilient to attacks where an attacker can modify the elicitation URL. | app | The server author makes the identity check resistant to URL changes. The SDK does not serve that page. |
### client/roots

Specification page: <https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots>

| Id | Keyword | Party | Requirement | Status | Tests or reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [client/roots#001-5acd21](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots) | SHOULD NOT | both | New implementations SHOULD NOT adopt it; existing implementations SHOULD migrate to passing directories or files via tool parameters, resource URIs, or server configuration. | app | The application decides whether to use roots. The server keeps roots off by default in Server.Options.mrtr.roots. |
| [client/roots#002-626c7b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#capabilities) | MUST | client | Clients that support roots MUST declare the `roots` capability in `_meta.io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities` on each request: | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): client declares elicitation, sampling and roots in _meta on every round (Checks the capabilities in every request frame, also the retry round.) |
| [client/roots#003-144c5a](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#root) | MUST | client | This MUST be a `file://` URI in the current specification. | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): client sends only file URIs as roots (The client fails the request when the list_roots hook returns another scheme.) |
| [client/roots#004-fc9b29](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | MUST | client | Clients MUST: Only expose roots with appropriate permissions | app | The host decides which roots the list_roots hook returns. |
| [client/roots#005-9e33d1](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | MUST | client | Clients MUST: Validate all root URIs to prevent path traversal | app | The host validates the roots that its list_roots hook returns. The SDK checks only the file scheme. |
| [client/roots#006-8dccb7](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | MUST | client | Clients MUST: Implement proper access controls | app | The host applies access control in the list_roots hook. |
| [client/roots#007-bb0a21](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | MUST | client | Clients MUST: Monitor root accessibility | app | The host monitors its roots. The list_roots hook runs on each request. |
| [client/roots#008-5630f5](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Handle cases where roots become unavailable | app | The handler handles roots that become unavailable. |
| [client/roots#009-ae0646](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Respect root boundaries during operations | app | The handler keeps its operations inside the roots. |
| [client/roots#010-3e1198](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#security-considerations) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Validate all paths against provided roots | app | The handler validates paths against the roots from RequestContext.rootsResponse. |
| [client/roots#011-4b7cdd](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD: Prompt users for consent before exposing roots to servers | app | The host asks the user for consent before the list_roots hook returns. |
| [client/roots#012-92ab26](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD: Provide clear user interfaces for root management | app | The host UI manages the roots. |
| [client/roots#013-6b1f94](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD: Validate root accessibility before exposing | app | The host checks each root before the list_roots hook returns it. |
| [client/roots#014-417796](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | client | Clients SHOULD: Monitor for root changes | app | The host monitors its roots. The list_roots hook runs on each request. |
| [client/roots#015-705908](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Check for roots capability before usage | tested | [client_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/client_features_test.zig): server asks for roots only when the client declared the roots capability (The server returns -32021 instead of a roots/list request.) |
| [client/roots#016-67b45b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Respect root boundaries in operations | app | The handler keeps its operations inside the roots. |
| [client/roots#017-9ce8bb](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/client/roots#implementation-guidelines) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD: Cache root information appropriately | app | The handler caches the roots that RequestContext.rootsResponse gives. |

| [server/prompts#016-27fb2c](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/prompts#error-handling) | SHOULD | server | Servers SHOULD return standard JSON-RPC errors for common failure cases: Internal errors: `-32603` (Internal error) | tested | [server_features_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/server_features_test.zig): prompts/get validates arguments, reports handler failures and supports input required (A handler failure becomes -32603.) |

| [server/utilities/caching#013-fb6583](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#time-to-live-ttl-field) | SHOULD | client | If `ttlMs` is positive, the client SHOULD consider the result fresh for that many milliseconds after receiving the response. | tested | [client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/client/client_test.zig): the result cache serves reads with a lifetime until invalidated |
| [server/utilities/caching#014-13ee1f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#time-to-live-ttl-field) | SHOULD | client | If `ttlMs` is absent, clients SHOULD assume a default of `0` (immediately stale) and rely on their own caching heuristics or notifications. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client treats a zero, absent or negative ttl as immediately stale |
| [server/utilities/caching#015-62d6b1](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#time-to-live-ttl-field) | SHOULD | client | If `ttlMs` is negative, clients SHOULD ignore it and treat it as `0`. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client treats a zero, absent or negative ttl as immediately stale |
| [server/utilities/caching#016-bd96fb](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#time-to-live-ttl-field) | MUST | server | Servers MUST provide a `ttlMs` value that is `>= 0`. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): server sends negative ttl hints as zero<br>`conformance:server/caching` |
| [server/utilities/caching#017-66632f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#time-to-live-ttl-field) | MAY | server | Servers MAY change the underlying data before the TTL expires. | app | The application changes its data at any time. The SDK does not freeze data during the TTL. |
| [server/utilities/caching#018-4f05f9](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#freshness-calculation) | SHOULD | client | Once the TTL expires, the response is stale and the client SHOULD re-fetch on next access. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client fetches an expired page again with its cursor |
| [server/utilities/caching#019-cfa756](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#freshness-calculation) | SHOULD NOT | client | Clients SHOULD NOT treat TTL as a polling interval that triggers automatic background refetches. | app | The SDK cache never fetches in the background. Polling is a choice of the application. |
| [server/utilities/caching#020-7e57a4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#freshness-calculation) | MUST | both | Implementations that do choose to poll MUST apply jitter and backoff. | app | The SDK does not poll on TTL. An application that polls must add jitter and backoff. |
| [server/utilities/caching#021-2594e2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#freshness-calculation) | MAY | client | Clients MAY re-fetch before the TTL expires if they have reason to believe the data has changed (e.g., receiving an unexpected error on a tool call indicating the method was not found or the parameters were invalid). | tested | [client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/client/client_test.zig): the result cache serves reads with a lifetime until invalidated (The refresh mode and Client.invalidateCache fetch again before the TTL expires.) |
| [server/utilities/caching#022-61dfca](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#freshness-calculation) | MAY | client | Clients MAY serve stale responses if errors occur during re-fetching (e.g., network issues, server downtime). | n/a | Optional feature that the SDK does not implement. The client cache drops an expired entry and never serves it. |
| [server/utilities/caching#023-66854e](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#cache-scope-field) | MAY | client | `"public"`: Any client, shared gateway, or caching proxy MAY store and serve the cached response to any user. | n/a | The SDK has no shared gateway or caching proxy. The client cache belongs to one client instance. |
| [server/utilities/caching#024-98bdd4](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#cache-scope-field) | MAY | server | `"private"`: Cached responses MAY be reused for the same authorization context. | tested | [client_test.zig](../../src/mcp/client/client_test.zig): the result cache serves reads with a lifetime until invalidated<br>[utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client caches are not shared between client instances (The same client serves a private read from its cache.) |
| [server/utilities/caching#025-7775a2](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#cache-scope-field) | MUST NOT | server | `"private"`: Caches MUST NOT be shared across authorization contexts (e.g. a different access token requires a different cache). | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client keeps private cache entries apart by authorization context<br>[utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client caches are not shared between client instances<br>[cache.zig](../../src/mcp/client/cache.zig): private entries belong to one authorization context |
| [server/utilities/caching#026-5828bf](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-notifications) | MAY | server | A server MAY provide `ttlMs` without advertising `listChanged: true` in its capabilities. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): server sends ttl hints with and without listChanged |
| [server/utilities/caching#027-225167](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-notifications) | MAY | server | A server MAY advertise `listChanged: true` and provide `ttlMs`. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): server sends ttl hints with and without listChanged |
| [server/utilities/caching#028-235957](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | MAY | server | Servers MAY return different `ttlMs` values on different pages (e.g., a longer TTL for early pages of a stable list, a shorter TTL for the final page). | n/a | Optional feature that the SDK does not offer. | [server/utilities/caching#029-abea8f](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | SHOULD | client | When a cached page expires, the client SHOULD re-fetch that page using its cursor. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client fetches an expired page again with its cursor |
| [server/utilities/caching#030-1cc448](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | SHOULD | client | Clients that require a consistent snapshot of the full list SHOULD re-fetch from the beginning (without a cursor). | app | The application decides when it needs a snapshot. The SDK gives a list call with a null cursor and the refresh cache mode. |
| [server/utilities/caching#031-269b9d](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | SHOULD | client | If a cursor becomes invalid (e.g., the server returns an error for a previously valid cursor), the client SHOULD discard all cached pages and re-fetch from the beginning. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): client drops the cached pages of a list after an invalid cursor error (The client drops the cached pages and returns the error. The application fetches the list again from the start.) |
| [server/utilities/caching#032-54a671](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | MUST | server | Servers MUST apply the same `cacheScope` to all response pages for a given list request. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): server applies the same cache scope and ttl to every page of a list |
| [server/utilities/caching#033-429390](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#interaction-with-pagination) | MUST | server | For example, if the first page of a `tools/list` response has `cacheScope: "private"`, all subsequent pages for that request MUST also be `"private"`. | tested | [utilities_test.zig](../../src/mcp/spec_test/utilities_test.zig): server applies the same cache scope and ttl to every page of a list |
| [server/utilities/caching#034-d81c3b](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#security-considerations) | MUST | server | Servers MUST be aware that responses with a `"public"` `cacheScope` may be shared between callers even if the Result is coming from an authenticated endpoint. | app | The server author chooses the scope with Server.Options.cache. The SDK default scope is private. |
| [server/utilities/caching#035-bf5a32](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/utilities/caching#security-considerations) | MUST | server | Server implementors: MUST apply appropriate per-primitive access controls, and MUST NOT rely on `cacheScope` alone to prevent unauthorized access to primitives. | app | The handler enforces access control for each primitive. The SDK gives RequestContext.principal. |
